en.p: For two geometric sequences $\{a_n\}$, $\{b_n\}$, each with nonzero first term and nonzero common ratio, the two series $\displaystyle\sum_{n=1}^{\infty}a_n$, $\displaystyle\sum_{n=1}^{\infty}b_n$ each converge, and
hold. When $\displaystyle\sum_{n=1}^{\infty}\frac{b_{2n-1}+b_{3n+1}}{b_n}=S$, find the value of $120S$. [4 points]
